900.name: On The Swift Flowing River
900.description:
As the river exits the city of Garathorm it picks up speed and whisks you
along high banks flanked by the trees of Haon-Dor. As the city fades in
the east, you approach a gloomy forest to the west. The roar of water
fills your ears. Waves crash and foam relentlessly.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark River.

west.description: Deep waters churn near The Riverbank

901.name: The Riverbank
901.description:
The river is deep, and runs swiftly in an east-west direction. To the
north the river eddies and enters a backwash where a small bank extends
down from a dark, thick stand of trees. It doesn't look particulary
inviting however. The roar of water fills your ears. The depths are dark
and unknowable.

north.description: To the north lies A Small Path On The River Bank In The Deep, Dark Forest.

east.description: Deep waters churn near On The Swift Flowing River

west.description: Deep waters churn near The Twisty Part Of The River

902.name: The Twisty Part Of The River
902.description:
The river twists and turns and nearly tosses you out of your boat. The
water is dark, cold, almost reptilian in sheen. It seems almost alive.
The river runs east and south. Waves crash and foam relentlessly. The
water churns with dangerous currents.

east.description: Deep waters churn near The Riverbank

903.name: The Scenic Route
903.description:
The dark forest of Haon-Dor recedes behind to the northeast. The river
continues in a westerly direction toward the river delta, where you can
just make out a large island. The water churns with dangerous currents.
Waves crash and foam relentlessly.

east.description: Deep waters churn near The Twisty Part Of The River

west.description: Deep waters churn near The Swift River Delta

904.name: The Swift River Delta
904.description:
This is the edge of the river delta, where the river empties out on its
way to the sea. The water here is Black. Deep. Dark. Deadly. The tidal
waves sweep you around and around up and down. Spray mists the air
around. The depths are dark and unknowable.

north.description: Deep waters churn near The North Channel

east.description: Deep waters churn near The Scenic Route

west.description: Deep waters churn near Near The Rocks

905.name: Near The Rocks
905.description:
You bob up and down in the waves comming dangerously close to some
large, jagged rocks on the eastern shore of an unusual looking island.
There is no way you could possibly land there without getting killed.
The depths are dark and unknowable. Waves crash and foam relentlessly.

east.description: Deep waters churn near The Swift River Delta

south.description: Deep waters churn near The South River Delta

906.name: The South River Delta
906.description:
The way leads along a channel in the river delta between the island to
the west and the shore to the south and east. To the south an aging
broken down looking pier juts out from land and toward the west the
channel works it way close to the island as it moves around its southern
tip. Waves crash and foam relentlessly. Spray mists the air around.

north.description: Deep waters churn near Near The Rocks

south.description: Deep waters churn near The Pier

907.name: The Pier
907.description:
You float next to a crumbling pier long since neglected. To the west the
water gets sluggish and there are many weeds and some seaweed floating
about. The depths are dark and unknowable. Waves crash and foam
relentlessly.

north.description: Deep waters churn near The South River Delta

west.description: Deep waters churn near Mired In Seaweed

908.name: Mired In Seaweed
908.description:
The going is rough here. The tide struggles with the normal flow of the
river and here near the edge of the sea there is a large amount of
growth. To the west the channel passes the southern tip of the island
and heads for open waters. Waves crash and foam relentlessly. The depths
are dark and unknowable.

east.description: Deep waters churn near The Pier

west.description: Deep waters churn near The Last Stop

909.name: The Last Stop
909.description:
The delta meets the sea here. To the west you see nothing but ocean on
the horizon. Sea birds squawk noisily at your approach and take flight
from a nearby beach head on the island. It looks as though this could be
the last stop for those heading out to sea. The roar of water fills your
ears. Spray mists the air around.

north.description: An open path leads to The Beach Head

east.description: Deep waters churn near Mired In Seaweed

910.name: The Beach Head
910.description:
This is a secluded looking beach on the southern tip of the island.
There isn't much to see here and there is no way to cross the steep
rocky cliffs that wall in this place. The air is fresh and clean. Tall
grass sways in a gentle breeze.

south.description: Deep waters churn near The Last Stop

down.description: To the down lies The Pit of Minos.

up.description: To the up lies The Pit of Minos.

911.name: The North Channel
911.description:
The river splits as runs up against the island and a navigatble channel
slips off to the north and west. The roar of water fills your ears. The
depths are dark and unknowable.

south.description: Deep waters churn near The Swift River Delta

west.description: Deep waters churn near The North Channel

912.name: The North Channel
912.description:
The river current carries you swiftly westward as the channel begins to
narrow as it squeezes past the north end of the island. The roar of
water fills your ears. The water churns with dangerous currents.

east.description: Deep waters churn near The North Channel

west.description: Deep waters churn near Near The Isle

913.name: Near The Isle
913.description:
The area opens just off a small landing on the island that appears to be
nothing more than a short path that leads to the side of a hill. Spray
mists the air around. The depths are dark and unknowable.

east.description: Deep waters churn near The North Channel

south.description: The cobblestones lead to The Lane Of The Lying

914.name: The Land Of The Dying
914.description:
Bodies lie everywhere. Commoner, peasant, duke, duchess. The Gods will
not hear you call here. Hence they will not answer you. To the south the
path ends at a dark cave entrance. A sign has been posted beside the
entrance. Buildings crowd together on all sides. Vendors and pedestrians
bustle past.

north.description: Deep waters churn near Near The Isle

south.description: The cobblestones lead to The First Trial Of Minos

915.name: The First Trial Of Minos
915.description:
Ah... The passage opens in Minos' battlefield playground. Minos loves to
torture his people through these places. He collects the monsters of the
world and puts them here. The sounds of city life echo around. Buildings
crowd together on all sides.

east.description: The cobblestones lead to The Second Trial Of Minos

916.name: The Second Trial Of Minos
916.description:
Minos' voice reveberates from the four walls of this room: 'Get some
rest and make sure you're healed. You'll need it for the next monster in
my playground. Or are you strong enough?' To the south is the entrance
to the next challenge of Minos' stronghold. The cobblestones are worn
smooth by countless feet. Buildings crowd together on all sides.

south.description: A passage leads to The Third Trial Of Minos

west.description: To the west lies The First Trial Of Minos.

917.name: The Third Trial Of Minos
917.description:
You go inside a red room. Very red. As if the Minos King used them to
disembowel his guests. The path continues eastward. You see blue lights
in that direction. The ceiling hangs low overhead. The air is still and
musty.

east.description: A passage leads to The Fourth Trial Of Minos

north.description: To the north lies The Second Trial Of Minos.

918.name: The Fourth Trial Of Minos
918.description:
Minos must be a monster hacking machine. You see a blue light flicker on
and off. A voice crackles, 'WHY ARE YOU HERE!' The walls are rough-hewn
and cold to the touch. The air is still and musty.

south.description: A passage leads to The Fifth Trial Of Minos

919.name: The Fifth Trial Of Minos
919.description:
This is General Woundwort's quarters. Hraka abound. The frayed corpses
of rabbits lie scattered about this hell-hole. The General is not a very
neat person as you can tell. Dust motes drift in the stale air. The air
is still and musty.

east.description: A passage leads to The Sixth Trial Of Minos

920.name: The Sixth Trial Of Minos
920.description:
Dare we surmise how many more rooms Minos has? The paths appear to be
endless. You shudder the sounds of death cries from the east. A loud
voice bellows another warning: 'Leave now or face my wrath!' There is a
crawlway leading upwards at the far end of the room and there is a fresh
breeze comming from there. Dust motes drift in the stale air. The walls
are rough-hewn and cold to the touch.

south.description: A passage leads to The Final Trial Of Minos

up.description: To the up lies The Pit of Minos.

921.name: The Final Trial Of Minos
921.description:
This is Minos' room. What else did you expect? The room is lavishly
decorated for this bovine king. Everything is so opulent that it makes
your eyes bulge. Survive and reap his fortune! The only exit is a large
oak door in the east wall. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the
touch. Dust motes drift in the stale air.

east.description: To the east lies The Pit of Minos.

2701.name: Entrance To The Castle Of Caboon

north.description: To the north lies The Painted Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Dead End.

2701.description:
This is the entrance hall of the Castle Of Caboon, a high, cold chamber
of black stone where every sound echoes. Faded banners hang in rags from
iron poles along the walls, and the flagstones are thick with dust and
drifted leaves. To the north, a pair of tall inner doors is barred with
a beam of oak and bound with chains, sealing off whatever lies beyond.
The open archway leads back south to the dead end.

extra_descs.doors inner beam chains:
The doors are twice the height of a man, carved with a pattern of
painted vines now flaking away. A great oak beam rests across them in
iron brackets, and heavy chains are looped through the handles and
locked with a rusted padlock the size of a fist.

2703.name: The Edge Of The Abandoned Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Circle Of Trees.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Path.

2703.description:
The living forest ends here, and beyond lies the abandoned forest: a
grey expanse of dead and dying trees, their bark peeling, their branches
bare and black against the sky. Behind you to the north, green trees
stand in a close ring around a huge old tree. A path of dark, ashy earth
leads south between the dead trunks. The air is silent and smells
faintly of rot.

2705.name: The Dark Path

north.description: To the north lies The Edge Of The Abandoned Forest.

east.description: To the east lies The Dark Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Path.

2705.description:
The path of black, ashy earth forks here among the dead trees, one
branch winding east and another bending south through thickets of
withered bramble. Every tree in sight is dead, grey and leafless, and
some have fallen across one another in great tangles. Above the bare
branches the sky is a dull, heavy grey. The edge of the living forest
lies back north.

2711.name: The Dark Path

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Dead End.

2711.description:
The path here runs through a stand of dead birches, their white bark
peeled and blackened so that they look like bones standing upright in
the earth. Pale fungus grows in brackets up their trunks. A cold mist
hangs low over the ground, curling around your ankles. The path leads
north to the fork, and west into a thicket.

2712.name: A Dead End

east.description: To the east lies The Dark Path.

2712.description:
The path ends among the roots of a huge dead yew, its hollow trunk split
open wide enough to show a dark, empty cavity inside. Thorn and dead
bracken close in around it on every side. A smell of old smoke clings to
the hollow, as if someone once sheltered there. The only way back is
east.

2713.name: The Dark Path

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark Path.

2713.description:
The path turns here at the foot of a great oak that was split by
lightning long ago, its two halves leaning apart like the jaws of a
trap. The wood inside is charred black. Dead heather crackles underfoot,
brittle as old paper, and a cold wind sighs through the bare twigs. The
path leads south and west.

2714.name: The Dark Path

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Path.

east.description: To the east lies The Dark Path.

2714.description:
A ditch of stagnant black water runs beside the path here, its surface
skinned with oily rainbows and dead leaves. The path squeezes between
the ditch and a wall of thornbushes that have grown wild and tangled. A
sour smell rises from the water. The way leads north toward a lightning-
blasted oak, and east deeper into the dead wood.

2720.name: The Dark Path

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark Path.

2720.description:
The remains of an old stone wall run alongside the path here, its stones
tumbled and furred with black moss, perhaps once the boundary of some
field or estate. Through gaps in the dead trees, the dark towers of a
castle can be glimpsed in the distance. Grey toadstools grow in a ring
on the bare earth. The path bends north and west.

2728.name: The Dark Path

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Path.

east.description: To the east lies A Dead End.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Path.

2728.description:
The path splits once more among the grey trunks, and a narrow side track
wanders off east into a thicket. The ground here is soft and black, and
every footprint fills slowly with dark water. Old nests of sticks crown
the highest dead branches. The main path runs on north toward the dark
towers, and back south along the old wall.

2729.name: A Dead End

west.description: To the west lies The Dark Path.

2729.description:
The side track ends at the edge of a steep pit, a sinkhole in the black
earth whose sides are slick with mud and whose bottom is lost in
stagnant water. Dead roots stick out of its walls like grasping fingers.
A cold breath rises from the water, smelling of rot. There is nowhere to
go but back west to the path.

2730.name: A Dead End

east.description: To the east lies The Dark Path.

2730.description:
The path peters out here against a wall of blackthorn so dense that not
even a hand could pass through it. The thorns are long and cruel, and
scraps of cloth hang from them where others have tried. The dead trees
lean in overhead, creaking in the wind. The only way out is back east.

2731.name: The Dark Path

east.description: To the east lies The Dead End.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Path.

west.description: To the west lies A Dead End.

2731.description:
The dead trees close in here, and the path ends in a small clearing
hemmed by thorn, with gaps leading east and west. The towers of a castle
loom very near now above the bare branches, their windows dark. A tall
gibbet of black timber stands in the clearing, its chains rusted and
empty. The path runs back south.

extra_descs.gibbet chains cage:
The gibbet is a post of tarred timber with an iron cage hanging from its
arm on rusted chains. The cage is empty, but its bars are bent outward,
as if whatever was held there forced its way free.

2732.name: The Dead End

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Castle Of Caboon.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark Path.

2732.description:
The dark path ends here before the gate of a grim stone castle, whose
walls rise sheer and black from the dead earth. The gate stands open to
the north, a deep archway leading into shadow. Heavy iron studs cover
its weathered doors, and a carved stone crest above the arch has been
chiselled away. The only other way is west, back along the path.

3224.name: Road Through The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Gatehouse.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies Road Through The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

3224.description:
The road leaves the Southern Gatehouse of Garathorm just to the north
and strikes out across the open plains, its cobbles soon giving way to
packed earth and dust. Deep wheel ruts and the prints of hooves and
boots mark its surface. On either side the grass runs off east and west,
waving in the wind. The road runs straight on south.

3225.name: Road Through The Plains

north.description: To the north lies Road Through The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies Road Through The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

3225.description:
The road runs straight and dusty through the heart of the plains, a pale
ribbon between tall banks of grass. A squat milestone stands at the
verge, its carving worn but still legible. Wildflowers crowd the
roadside, and the wind brings the smell of distant woodsmoke. The road
leads north back to the city gate and south into open country, while the
grass spreads east and west.

extra_descs.milestone stone:
A block of grey granite with a rounded top, half sunk in the verge. Its
weathered face reads Garathorm, one mile, with the city's tower sigil
cut beneath.

3226.name: Road Through The Plains

north.description: To the north lies Road Through The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies Wilderness Way.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

3226.description:
The road begins to roughen here as it runs south toward wilder country,
its ruts deeper and its verges wild with gorse and broom. Behind it, to
the north, the walls of Garathorm have shrunk to a grey line above the
grass. A weathered signpost stands at the roadside, its arm pointing on
to Wilderness Way. The plains spread east and west on either hand.

extra_descs.signpost post arm:
The post is a split log with a single arm nailed to it. The letters
burned into the arm read Wilderness Way, and someone has cut a small,
crude arrow beneath them.

3504.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

south.description: If you go south, you will enter the Miden'Nir.

3504.description:
Though the open grassland lies only a stone's throw to the north, the
ground here is already wooded, a light stand of silver birch and young
oak with grass growing thick between the trunks. Sunlight dapples the
ground, and the air is warm and still. A faint smell of woodsmoke drifts
through the branches from somewhere deeper in. A trail leads south
between the trees toward the forest of Miden'nir.

3505.name: The Trail To The Forest Of Miden'Nir
3505.description:
This is a light forest. A path leads south, but the passage to the east
is easy enough. To the west, smoke can be seen rising above the
treetops. The sprawl of Garathorm lies north of here. Bird calls echo
through the canopy. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: To the north, you see the South Gate of Garathorm.

east.description: More light forest.

south.description: This path cuts through the darkness of the Miden'Nir.

3506.name: The Forest Of Miden'Nir
3506.description:
This is a dark forest. To the east, mountains block passage. From here,
only the lighter forest to the west or south offer a way to travel. The
scent of pine and earth fills the air. Branches intertwine overhead,
filtering the light.

south.description: The forest is darker to the south.

west.description: The forest gets lighter as you go west.

3507.name: The Forest Of Miden'Nir
3507.description:
The forest is deep here and the wind blows through the trees and through
your hair. To the north, the forest gets lighter. However, the southern
and western paths place you even deeper in the wood. The scent of pine
and earth fills the air. Ancient trees rise on all sides.

north.description: The forest is lighter in this direction.

east.description: To the east lies The Forest Of Miden'Nir.

south.description: More and darker woods.

west.description: There is a small path leading west.

3508.name: On A Small Path
3508.description:
A path is here, leading east and south through the dark woods of
Miden'nir. Mountains slash the scenery to the west of here. Bird calls
echo through the canopy. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen
leaves.

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: Wind-swept forest.

south.description: To the south, the trail continues.

3509.name: The Forest Of Miden'Nir
3509.description:
The trees of Miden'nir are lush and green, hiding the evil that lurks in
these woods. The trees become too thick to the west, but you may go
north, south or travel toward the mountains that lie east of here. Bird
calls echo through the canopy. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering
the light.

north.description: The trees lighten up a bit this way.

east.description: Huge grey mountains lie in this direction.

south.description: The forest continues.

west.description: To the west lies The Forest Of Miden'Nir.

3510.name: The Crossroads
3510.description:
Here footworn paths meet leading north, south and east. The trees seem
to be closing in on you at this point, and you can barely see the sky
through the thick branches above your head. Bird calls echo through the
canopy. Ancient trees rise on all sides.

north.description: Trees as far as the eye can see.

east.description: There is an especially dark part of the forest this way.

south.description: There is an especially dark section of forest this way.

west.description: To the west lies The Trail.

3511.name: The Trail
3511.description:
The area is a north-south trail through the woods. To the west,
impassable mountains glare at you, and the thick woods and undergrowth
prevent any movement westward. Ancient trees rise on all sides. Branches
intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: The trail bends to the north.

east.description: To the east lies The Crossroads.

south.description: To the south, the path re-enters the forest.

3512.name: At The Edge Of The Plains

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: A light section of forest.

west.description: The forest continues here.

3512.description:
Here the forest of Miden'nir thins out at its eastern margin, and
between the trunks the open plains shine bright with sunlight. The
undergrowth has been trampled flat in places, and a crude stake hung
with knotted cords and small bones has been driven into the ground
beneath an oak. The air smells of old smoke and something rank. The
woods grow thicker and greener to the west, while the forest's edge runs
on south.

extra_descs.stake cords bones:
A sharpened stake taller than a man, with strings of knotted cord
hanging from its tip. Tiny bones and teeth are threaded on the cords,
and they click together in the wind like a warning.

3513.name: At The Edge Of The Forest

north.description: There is a small clearing to the north.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

west.description: It gets darker and thicker this way.

3513.description:
The plains give way here to the first trees of Miden'nir, tall oaks and
beeches whose roots heave the ground into ridges beneath a carpet of
leaf mould. Light still streams in from the open grass to the east, but
westward the trunks crowd closer and the shadows deepen toward the deep
forest. A fallen beech lies along the margin, its bark peeling in long
strips. The edge of the woods runs on north.

3514.name: Deep Forest
3514.description:
It is quite dark here, forest surrounds you. With each step, the forest
seems to close around, and get darker and more foreboding. It might
just be time to head back to somewhere safe. Branches intertwine
overhead, filtering the light. The scent of pine and earth fills the
air.

north.description: More forest.

east.description: Lighter forest and mountains in the distance.

south.description: More trees.

west.description: The forest continues.

3515.name: Light Forest
3515.description:
The forest is light here and you can easily pick your way through the
trail. To the east, the forest becomes thick and darker. South, the
trail continues. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light. The
forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves.

north.description: A trail leading north-south.

east.description: The trees get thicker as you go east.

south.description: More trees and some small hills.

3516.name: The Sinkhole
3516.description:
The forest floor sags here into a broad sinkhole, a sunken bowl of black
mud where rainwater stands in brown pools between the roots. Your boots
sink to the ankle with every step, and each one comes free with a wet,
sucking squelch. Gnarled oaks lean over the rim, their bared roots
hanging like old rope above the water. Trails climb out of the hollow
north to the crossroads, east toward the mountains, south onto a darker
path, and west where the trees grow thinner and the light returns.

north.description: The Miden'nir continues.

east.description: More trees.

south.description: The trees get VERY thick to the south.  You can barely see...

west.description: Some light trees and daylight.

3517.name: Near The Mountains
3517.description:
The most prominent feature here is the mountains that lie to the east.
You can only go north and west from here as the rocks stop all other
movement. Bird calls echo through the canopy. Branches intertwine
overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: Many trees to the north.

west.description: There is a bit of a slope downward to the west.

3518.name: The Fading Trail
3518.description:
The trail becomes nearly unpassable here. You can go north as the forest
is relatively light. To the south, Visible is a path. The forest floor
is carpeted with fallen leaves. Bird calls echo through the canopy.

north.description: You can see a trail this way.

south.description: Dark forests.

west.description: To the west lies On The Verge Of Darkness.

3519.name: The Dark Path
3519.description:
The area is hemmed in by trees on either side of you. The path continues
north and south, and while is much to thick to explore west, you can
head off into the woods to the west. Branches intertwine overhead,
filtering the light. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.

north.description: The forest gets lighter this way.

south.description: There is a strong stench coming from this direction.

203520.name: On The Verge Of Darkness

east.description: To the east lies The Fading Trail.

west.description: To the west lies A Dead End Path In The Deep, Dark Forest.

203520.description:
Here the lighter woods give way to something older and darker, and the
trail shrinks to a thread between ancient trunks. Behind you to the
east, the faint trail still shows among ferns and green light, but
westward the trees stand shoulder to shoulder, their crowns knitting
into a black roof. The air turns cool and still, and somewhere beyond
the trees a river murmurs in the dark. Each step forward feels like a
step out of the day.

3521.name: Carnage

extra_descs: carcass body corpse carcasses bodies corpses

3521.description:
Here, you see a gruesome sight. Blood is everywhere... on the trees and
soaked into the ground. Two carcasses lie ahead, seeming to look up at
you. The forest is impassible to the south, but the other directions
look ok. Ancient trees rise on all sides. The scent of pine and earth
fills the air.

north.description: Darkness...

west.description: More dark forest.

3522.name: The Stench
3522.description:
There is a sickening stench here. It smells of blood and death. To the
north, you catch glimpses of daylight. To the east, you simply cannot
see. The trees are close and stifling. Ancient trees rise on all sides.
The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves.

north.description: You see daylight and a trail to follow.

east.description: The stench seems to becoming from this direction.

4300.name: The Cliff Edge

north.description: To the north lies The Forest Path.

south.description: To the south lies Thin Air.

down.description: To the down lies The Narrow Steps.

4300.description:
The forest ends abruptly at the brink of a sheer cliff, and the wind
howls up out of the empty space where the land falls away. Far below,
broken country of rock and scrub fades into haze. Narrow steps are cut
down the cliff face, but a barricade of boulders and lashed timbers,
grown over with thorn, blocks the way down. To the south a small stone
hut perches on a spur of rock above the void, and the path leads back
north into the pines.

extra_descs.barricade steps boulders timbers:
Fallen boulders have been wedged together with rough-hewn timbers and
lashed tight with rope gone grey with age. Briars have grown all through
the barricade, and a crude mark daubed in red ochre on the topmost stone
warns travellers away from the steps below.

4301.name: Thin Air

north.description: To the north lies The Cliff Edge.

4301.description:
The hut is a single round room of dry-stacked stone, so small that a
tall traveller could touch both walls with outstretched arms. A narrow
window in the far side looks out on nothing but empty air and, very far
below, the haze of the lowlands, and the wind moans through every chink
in the stones. A stone bench runs around the wall beneath a roof of
slate. The only door leads north, back to the cliff edge.

4330.name: The Forest Path

north.description: To the north lies On The Bridge.

south.description: To the south lies The Cliff Edge.

4330.description:
The path winds through a wood of old pines whose needles carpet the
ground in a soft brown layer that muffles every step. The trees begin to
thin to the south, where the light grows strangely bright and open, and
the wind carries a chill. The sound of rushing water drifts from the
bridge to the north. Resin scents the cool air.

4331.name: On The Bridge

north.description: To the north lies The Small Hill.

south.description: To the south lies The Forest Path.

4331.description:
A narrow wooden bridge spans a rocky stream here, its planks grey and
warped, its rails polished smooth by countless hands. The water rushes
white over the stones below, flashing under an open strip of sky. A
small hill rises beyond the bridge to the north, and to the south a path
disappears among the trees. Moss grows thick on the bridge's timbers
wherever the spray reaches them.

4332.name: The Small Hill

north.description: To the north lies A Small Path In The Dense Forest.

south.description: To the south lies On The Bridge.

4332.description:
A small, rounded hill rises here out of the forest, its crown bare of
trees and covered in short grass and wild thyme. From the top you can
see the dense woods spreading on every side under a wide sky. A small
path leads north into the trees, and to the south the ground falls away
toward a wooden bridge. The wind blows freely across the summit, bending
the grass.

6000.name: The Edge Of The Forest
6000.description:
The area opens at the end of a dusty road, near the eastern edge of the
large forest of Haon-Dor. To the east you see the road heading back to
the walled city, Garathorm, and to the west is a narrow trail leading
through the forest. The air is fresh and clean. Wildflowers dot the
landscape.

east.description: To the east a dusty road takes you back to the walls of Garathorm, and its large west gate.

west.description: You see a narrow forest trail winding westward in between the trees.

6001.name: A Trail Through The Light Forest
6001.description:
The area is a trail leading through the forest. There seems to be a
small path leading north into the shadows. To the east is the forest
edge and to the west the trail leads further into the forest. The forest
floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. Bird calls echo through the
canopy.

north.description: You see evidence of a small path leading through a break in the trees to the north.

east.description: The trail continues eastwards out of the forest.

west.description: You see the narrow forest trail winding westwards in between the trees.

6002.name: A Trail Through The Light Forest
6002.description:
The area is a narrow trail winding east and west through the forest. To
the west, the forest gradually becomes more dense. A small forest path
leads off to the south. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the
light. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.

east.description: The trail continues eastwards through the young trees.

south.description: The small path leads south through the young trees.

west.description: You see the narrow forest trail winding westwards into the dense forest.

6003.name: A Trail Through The Dense Forest
6003.description:
The area is a trail winding east and west through the dense forest. To
the east, the forest gradually seems to become lighter. The forest floor
is carpeted with fallen leaves. The scent of pine and earth fills the
air.

east.description: The trail continues eastwards to the younger part of the forest.

west.description: You see the narrow trail winding westwards through the dense forest.

6004.name: A Trail Through The Dense Forest
6004.description:
The area is a trail winding east and west through the dense forest. To
the west, the trees are so huge and their crowns so dense that forest
remains in total darkness. A small path leads south through the trees.
Ancient trees rise on all sides. The forest floor is carpeted with
fallen leaves.

east.description: The trail continues eastwards through the dense forest.

south.description: The small path leads south through the trees.

west.description: The narrow trail almost seems to disappear between the enormous trunks.

6005.name: A Small Path In The Dense Forest
6005.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of
the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The
path continues north and south. A patch of moss to the west looks
freshly disturbed. The scent of pine and earth fills the air. Bird calls
echo through the canopy.

north.description: The small path leads north through the trees.

south.description: The small path leads south through the trees.

6006.name: A Small Path In The Dense Forest
6006.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of
the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The
path continues north and east. The scent of pine and earth fills the
air. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves.

north.description: The small path leads north through the trees.

east.description: The small path leads east through the trees.

6007.name: An Intersection In The Dense Forest
6007.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of
the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The
forest gradually lightens to the east. Paths lead east, west and south.
Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light. Bird calls echo
through the canopy.

east.description: You can barely make out a clearing to the east.

south.description: The small path leads south through the trees.

west.description: The small path leads west through the trees.

6008.name: The Forest Clearing

extra_descs.ven though the logs have been chopped to: as they are fresh and still filled with sap.

6008.description:
This is a clearing in the forest. Lots of fresh stumps of varying sizes
protrude from the ground and heavy logs are stacked neatly in a big pile
supported by stakes set into the ground. Paths lead north, east and
west. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. The scent of pine
and earth fills the air.

north.description: The small path leads north through the trees.

east.description: The small path leads east through the trees.

west.description: The small path leads west through the trees.

6009.name: Outside A Small Cabin In The Forest
6009.description:
The area is outside a small cabin built entirely from heavy logs. There
is a wooden door to the north and small paths lead west and south
through the trees. Bird calls echo through the canopy. The forest floor
is carpeted with fallen leaves.

north.description: The wooden door is quite sturdy but does not appear to be equipped with a lock.

south.description: The small path leads south through the dense forest.

west.description: The small path leads west through the light forest.

6010.name: Inside The Cabin
6010.description: The interior of the small cabin is rustic but well-maintained. A stone fireplace dominates one wall, and simple wooden furniture fills the space.

south.description: A trail winds toward Outside A Small Cabin In The Forest

down.description: To the down lies Under A Trap Door.

6011.name: A Small Path Through The Light Forest
6011.description:
The area is a small path leading through the forest. The trees are tall
and slender. Paths lead north and south. Ancient trees rise on all
sides. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.

north.description: The path leads north through the young trees.

south.description: The path leads south through the young trees.

6012.name: An Intersection In The Dense Forest
6012.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of
the old trees leave the forest floor in an unreal twilight illumination.
Paths lead north, east and south. Ancient trees rise on all sides. The
forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves.

north.description: The small path leads north through the trees.

east.description: The small path leads east through the trees.

south.description: The small path leads south through the trees.

6013.name: A Small Path In The Dense Forest
6013.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of
the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The
path continues east and west. Ancient trees rise on all sides. Bird
calls echo through the canopy.

east.description: The small path leads east through the trees.

west.description: The small path leads west through the trees.

6014.name: An Intersection In The Dense Forest
6014.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The forest
gradually lightens to the north. Paths lead north, east and west.
Ancient trees rise on all sides. The forest floor is carpeted with
fallen leaves.

north.description: The path leads north to a lighter part of the forest.

east.description: The small path leads east through the trees.

west.description: The small path leads west through the trees.

6015.name: A Small Path In The Dense Forest
6015.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of
the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The
path continues south and west. Ancient trees rise on all sides. Branches
intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

south.description: The small path leads south through the trees.

west.description: The small path leads west through the trees.

6016.name: A Small Path In The Dense Forest
6016.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of
the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The
path continues north, south and east. Ancient trees rise on all sides.
Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: The small path leads north through the trees.

east.description: The small path leads east through the trees.

south.description: The small path leads south through the trees.

6017.name: A Small Path In The Dense Forest
6017.description:
This is a turn on a small path leading through the dense forest. The
forest seems to become lighter to the west. The path continues north and
west. Ancient trees rise on all sides. Bird calls echo through the
canopy.

north.description: The small path leads north through the trees.

west.description: The small path leads west through the trees to a lighter part of the forest.

6018.name: An Intersection In The Light Forest
6018.description:
The area is a small path leading through the forest. A path leads north
to a small field and other paths lead east and west into the dense
forest. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves. Ancient trees
rise on all sides.

north.description: The path leads north to a small, grassy field.

east.description: The path leads east to a dense part of the forest.

west.description: The path leads west to a dense part of the forest.

6019.name: A Small Path In The Dense Forest
6019.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The forest
seems to become lighter to the east. The path continues north and east.
The scent of pine and earth fills the air. Branches intertwine overhead,
filtering the light.

north.description: The small path leads north through the trees.

east.description: The small path leads east through the trees to a lighter part of the forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Small Hill.

6020.name: A Small Path In The Dense Forest
6020.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of
the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The
path continues south and west. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering
the light. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.

south.description: The small path leads south through the trees.

west.description: The small path leads west through the trees.

6021.name: A Small Path In The Dense Forest
6021.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. To the west
you see a dark cave entrance, leading into a small hillside. The path
continues north and east. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.
Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: The small path leads north through the trees.

east.description: The small path leads east through the trees.

west.description: The cave is very dark.

6022.name: Inside The cave
6022.description:
This is a natural cave. Various sorts of debris cover the stone floor,
emitting a rather unpleasant smell that makes the air thick and hard to
breathe. The only obvious exit is east. Dust motes drift in the stale
air. Shadows gather in the corners.

east.description: The cave opening is to the east.

6023.name: A Grassy Field
6023.description:
This is a grass covered field somewhere in the forest. The tall grass
nearly reaches your waist, and the surrounding oaks and beeches form an
almost wall-like thicket on the east side of the field. To the northeast
Visible is a small lake. A small path leads south through the trees, and
the field opens up to the north and west. The open sky stretches
overhead. The ground is soft underfoot.

north.description: Wind blowing in from the north carries with it the smell of a newly killed animal, as well as the noise of many birds, which you can see circling there.

east.description: The ground slopes gently downward to the eastern tree line.

south.description: The small path leads south in between the trees.

6024.name: Lower Part Of The Grassy Field
6024.description:
This is a lower part of the grassy field, south of a small lake. The
grass here has been trampled by the many animals coming here for water,
leaving the ground covered in tracks of different types. To the west you
see a break in the wall of trees surrounding the field, and to the north
is a small lake. Tall grass sways in a gentle breeze. The air is fresh
and clean.

north.description: The animal tracks lead off to the north, and around the lake there.

west.description: To the south-west you see a break in the tree line, leading back to the forest path.

6025.name: Beside The Lake In A Grassy Field
6025.description:
The grass stops shortly before the lake, replaced by mud covered in
tracks from the local animals. When you come close many animals scatter
into the tall grass and some even into the forest. To the west you see
birds circling in the high in the air, and to the north you see a small
lake, surrounded by tall reeds. The field continues to the south, and
the forest blocks passage to the east. The ground is soft underfoot. The
open sky stretches overhead.

north.description: The lake looks inviting, and you can see some sort of water fowl floating around among the reeds.

south.description: To the south an animal trail leads of towards a the other side of the lower field.

west.description: The smell of carrion drifts down to you from higher on the field to the west.

6026.name: The Northern Section Of A Grassy Field
6026.description:
As you come close, scavenging animals and birds of all sorts scatter,
leaving only the boldest and stupidest encircling the corpse of a large
boar. Carrion birds circle overhead, and smaller animals stare out of
the tall grass at you. The grass here has been trampled, and a large
area around the corpse is stained by blood. A trail leads down the
sloping field to a lake, and to the south you see the path back to the
forest. The ground is soft underfoot. The air is fresh and clean.

east.description: A small lake lies down the sloping field to the east.  Some of the animals that fled from here have gone there, and are watching, waiting for you to leave so they can resume their feasting.

south.description: The field continues to the south, and you can see the path back to the forest there.

6027.name: On The Lake
6027.description:
This is the middle of a small lake, fed from a small stream coming
through the forest from the northwest. The water is not that clear, but
Visible is fish swimming around below. The bank is clear to the south,
providing a safe place to get back to the field. Waves crash and foam
relentlessly. The roar of water fills your ears.

south.description: Some animals have gathered on the bank to watch you, curious about what you are doing.

6028.name: A Small Path In The Dense Forest
6028.description:
The area is a small path leading through the dense forest. The crowns of
the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The
path continues to the west and south. Ancient trees rise on all sides.
The scent of pine and earth fills the air.

south.description: To the south, a narrow trail slips toward Near A Large Tree In The Dense Forest. Sun-dappled leaves sway overhead and birdsong filters through the trees.

west.description: The small path leads west through the trees.

6029.name: Near A Large Tree In The Dense Forest
6029.description:
This is the end of a small path leading through the dense forest. The
crowns of the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight
illumination. This rough clearing is dominated by a very large oak tree,
probably the largest in this part of the forest. The path leads back to
the north. Ancient trees rise on all sides. Branches intertwine
overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: To the north, a narrow trail slips toward A Small Path In The Dense Forest. Sun-dappled leaves sway overhead and birdsong filters through the trees.

up.description: You see the lower branches of the towering oak.

6030.name: In The Lower Branches Of A Large Oak
6030.description:
This is a huge oak, about one third of the way to the top. The branches
above block out much of the light, but enough filters through for you to
see. Small animals and birds scatter at your approach, rustling the
leaves all about you. You could easily climb back down to the ground, or
continue up the tree. One large branch juts outward to the west,
possibly providing a third choice of exit. High in the branches, a
platform is barely visible among the leaves. The air is thin and cold at
this altitude. Snow clings to shadowed crevices.

west.description: This limb looks large and strong enough for you to walk most of the way along its length to the west.

down.description: The rough clearing is just a quick climb and jump below you.

6031.name: Out On A Limb In A Large Oak
6031.description:
This sturdy branch hangs far out over a path to the west, which you
might be able to jump down to. Several squirrels scamper into hiding as
you approach, leaving you alone and swaying slightly with the wind. To
your north Visible is a small log cabin through the trees, and to the
southeast there seems to be some sort of clearing, with many birds
circling above it. Bird calls echo through the canopy. The forest floor
is carpeted with fallen leaves.

east.description: Back to the east you see the tree trunk.  It is much less precarious there compared to here... perhaps you should go back.

down.description: Below you is a small path, probably used by the forest animals.  You think that you could jump down with a little effort.

6032.name: Midway To The Top Of The Large Oak
6032.description:
This is a huge oak, about midway to the top. The branches above block
out much of the light, but enough filters through for you to see. A few
birds have remained to watch you from the fringe branches, well out of
your reach. Scratches mar the tree here, and torn bark is scattered near
you on the branch. It would seem some large forest cat lives nearby, so
you had better be careful! You can continue a bit farther up the tree,
or descend to limbs that don't sway so much. The wind howls around
exposed peaks. Bare rock dominates the landscape.

up.description: Above you the tree narrows farther, but it still looks like you could climb up there.  A feline shape is pacing about above you, trying to get to a large wounded bird.  Perhaps you should try to see what sort of cat this is before you interrupt its hunt... it might eat you instead of the bird.

down.description: Below you, a narrow trail slips toward In The Lower Branches Of A Large Oak. Sun-dappled leaves sway overhead and birdsong filters through the trees.

6033.name: High In The Large Oak

extra_descs.view canopy: From the oak's crown the whole light forest sways beneath you. Haon-Dor wears its name well from up here.

6033.description: You have reached the crown of the massive oak tree. The canopy spreads around you, and through gaps in the leaves you can see for miles across the forest.

north.description: To the north lies A Shaded Path Through The Dense Forest.

down.description: Midway To The Top Of The Large Oak

6060.name: A Shaded Path Through The Forest
6060.description:
The area is a small shaded path leading through the trees. The forest
gradually lightens to the east. The path continues to the north, and to
the south you see the main trail. The scent of pine and earth fills the
air. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

south.description: Through a break in the tree line you see the main trail that heads back towards Garathorm.

6061.name: A Shaded Path Through The Forest
6061.description:
This is a turn on a small shadowed path leading through the forest. The
forest seems to become lighter to the west. The path continues north and
west. Ancient trees rise on all sides. The scent of pine and earth fills
the air.

north.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

west.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

6062.name: A Shaded Path Through The Dense Forest
6062.description:
The area is a small shaded path leading through the dense forest. The
crowns of the old trees leave the forest floor in an unreal twililght
illumination. To the north you see a small clearing. Paths lead east and
west. Ancient trees rise on all sides. The scent of pine and earth fills
the air.

north.description: Through the underbrush you see a small clearing.

east.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

south.description: To the south lies High In The Large Oak.

west.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

6063.name: A Shaded Path Through The Dense Forest
6063.description:
The area is a small shaded path through the dense forest. The crowns of
the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The
path continues north and east. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering
the light. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves.

north.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

east.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

6064.name: A Shadowy Path Through The Dense Forest
6064.description:
The area is a small shadowy path leading through the dense forest. The
crowns of the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight
illumination. The path continues north and south. The forest floor is
carpeted with fallen leaves. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the
light.

north.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

south.description: The path winds its way into darkness.

6065.name: A Shaded Path Through The Forest
6065.description:
This is a turn on a small shaded path winding through the trees. The
forest gradually becomes more dense to the west. The path continues west
and south from here. The scent of pine and earth fills the air. Ancient
trees rise on all sides.

south.description: Through the trees to the south you can almost see the main trail leading back to Garathorm.

west.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

6066.name: A Fork In The Shaded Path Through The Forest
6066.description:
This is a fork in the small shaded path winding through the trees. The
forest gradually becomes more dense to the west. The path branches to
the north and south here, and also continues to the east. Branches
intertwine overhead, filtering the light. Ancient trees rise on all
sides.

north.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

east.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

south.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

6067.name: At The Fallen Tree
6067.description:
This is a small clearing, beside a large fallen tree. A large amount of
the tree has already decomposed, but some pieces remain, scattered about
the clearing. Paths border the clearing to the north and south. The
scent of pine and earth fills the air. Ancient trees rise on all sides.

north.description: A shaded path winds its way northeast between the trees.

south.description: A shaded path winds its way east between the trees.

6068.name: An Intersection On The Shaded Path
6068.description:
The area is a small shaded path leading through the dense forest. The
crowns of the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight
illumination. The path continues north, south, and west. The scent of
pine and earth fills the air. Bird calls echo through the canopy.

north.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

south.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

west.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

6069.name: A Shadowy Path Through The Dense Forest
6069.description:
The area is a small shadowy path leading through the dense forest. The
crowns of the old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight
illumination. The path continues south and east. Branches intertwine
overhead, filtering the light. Ancient trees rise on all sides.

north.description: To the north lies In The Dense Forest Between The Hills.

east.description: The path winds its way between the old trees.

south.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

6070.name: Off Of The Path In The Shaded Forest
6070.description:
The area is wandering amongst the trees in the light forest, without the
aid of a path or trail. More sunlight trickles through the treetops
here, making your travel a bit easier. Small animals scurry away as you
approach. The area is no longer on a path, so you may go whichever way
you please. A stitched screen of leaves to the north looks out of place.
The scent of pine and earth fills the air. Branches intertwine overhead,
filtering the light.

north.description: To the north lies A Small Trail Through The Forest.

south.description: To the south lies A Shaded Path Through The Forest.

west.description: To the west lies A Shaded Path Through The Forest.

6071.name: A Shaded Path Through The Forest
6071.description:
The area is a small shaded path leading in between the trees. The forest
gradually lightens to the east. Paths lead west and south, and you think
you see a small path leading eastward. Bird calls echo through the
canopy. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: To the north lies Off Of The Path In The Shaded Forest.

south.description: The path winds its way through the trees to an split in the path.

west.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

6072.name: A Shaded Path Through the Forest
6072.description:
The area is a small shaded path leading between the trees. The forest
gradually becomes more dense to the west. Paths lead north and east, and
you see a small clearing to the south. Ancient trees rise on all sides.
Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: To the north lies In The Dense Forest Between The Hills.

east.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

south.description: A lightly traveled path heads southward to a small clearing.

6073.name: A Shadowy Path Through The Dense Forest
6073.description:
The area is a small shadowy path leading through the dense forest. To
the north the terrain becomes quite hilly and rough. The crowns of the
old trees leave the forest in an unreal twilight illumination. The path
continues north and south. Sheep trails wind between the hillocks. Rocks
jut from the grassy slopes.

north.description: The path winds its way into the hills and denser forest.

south.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

6074.name: A Small Trail Through The Forest
6074.description:
You have just left the shaded path, and you are now standing at the head
of a very short trail. It looks like someone begin clearing away the
underbrush here, but didn't get finished. You may leave in any
direction, but the path is to the west. The scent of pine and earth
fills the air. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

east.description: The trees seem to part, exposing a trail into the shade.

south.description: The trees seem to part, exposing a trail into the shade.

west.description: Through the underbrush you see a small path winding its way northward.

6075.name: A Shaded Path Through The Forest
6075.description:
The area is a small shaded path leading between the trees. The forest
gradually becomes more dense to the west, and to the northwest the
terrain is quite hilly. The path continues north and south. To the east
you see a trail winding through the younger section of the forest.
Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light. Bird calls echo
through the canopy.

north.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

east.description: You think you see the beginnings of a small trail through the younger part of the forest.

south.description: To the south lies In The Dense Forest Between The Hills.

west.description: To the west lies In The Dense Forest Between The Hills.

6076.name: In The Dense Forest Between The Hills
6076.description:
The area opens among tightly packed trees between several hills. You
lost track of the path long ago, and now must rely on your instincts to
guide you. The ground is very rough and rocky here, and only the most
hardy plants survive. The crowns of the old trees leave the hills in an
unreal twilight illumination. The view stretches for miles in every
direction. The wind carries the scent of wild herbs.

north.description: To the north lies In The Dense Forest Between The Hills.

east.description: All you see are trees and hillsides.

south.description: To the south lies A Shadowy Path Through The Dense Forest.

west.description: To the west lies In The Dense Forest Between The Hills.

6077.name: In The Dense Forest Between The Hills
6077.description:
The area opens among tightly packed trees between several hills. You
lost track of the path long ago, and now must rely on your instincts to
guide you. The ground is very rough and rocky here, and only the most
hardy plants survive. The crowns of the old trees leave the hills in an
unreal twilight illumination. Rocks jut from the grassy slopes. The view
stretches for miles in every direction.

north.description: To the north lies A Shaded Path Through The Forest.

south.description: To the south lies A Shaded Path Through the Forest.

west.description: To the west lies In The Dense Forest Between The Hills.

6078.name: In The Dense Forest Between The Hills
6078.description:
This is the end of a small shaded path leading between the trees. The
forest is quite thick here, and the ground is very rough and hilly,
halting your progress. The path lies to the south. The view stretches
for miles in every direction. Rocks jut from the grassy slopes.

south.description: The path winds its way between the trees.

6079.name: In The Dense Forest Between The Hills
6079.description:
The area opens among tightly packed trees between several hills. You
lost track of the path long ago, and now must rely on your instincts to

6090.name: A Road Through The Plains
6090.description:
The area is a dust covered east-west road through the western plains. An
occasional hunter or adventurer can be seen, heading to or from the
forest. To the east is the walled city, Garathorm, and to the west the
road ends at the head of a narrow trail into a large forest. Wildflowers
dot the landscape. The open sky stretches overhead.

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: Far to the east you see the large walls guarding Garathorm.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west the dusty trail ends, and becomes a narrow trail into the cool shadows of the forest.

6091.name: A Road Through The Plains

forest. To the east is the walled city, Garathorm, and to the west the
road continues towards a large forest. Tall grass sways in a gentle
breeze. The ground is soft underfoot.

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: Far to the east you see the walls and western gate of Garathorm.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: You see the large forest, Haon-Dor, stretching out far to the west, and to the northwest you the forest gives way to hills.

6092.name: A Road Through The Plains
6092.description:
The area is a dust covered east-west road crossing the grassy plains
between Garathorm the forest of Haon-Dor. An occasional hunter or
adventurer can be seen, heading to or from the forest. To the east is
the walled city, Garathorm, and to the west the road continues towards a
large forest. Buildings crowd together on all sides. The smell of smoke
and humanity hangs in the air.

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Western Gatehouse.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west the road continues towards the forest.

6100.name: A Narrow Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest
6100.description:
The area is a narrow trail winding its way between the enormous, grey
trunks. The crowns of the trees must be very dense, as they leave the
forest floor in utter darkness. The trail leads east and west. Bird
calls echo through the canopy. Ancient trees rise on all sides.

north.description: A small shadowy path leads away to the north.

east.description: The narrow trail leads east to a somewhat lighter part of the forest.

west.description: The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.

6101.name: A Narrow Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest
6101.description:
The area is a dusty trail winding its way east-west between huge,
ancient trees whose grey trunks remind you of ancient pillars in a
enormous, deserted hall. To the south, a frail path leads away from the
trail. Bird calls echo through the canopy. The scent of pine and earth
fills the air.

east.description: The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.

south.description: The path leads south - away from the trail.

west.description: The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.

6102.name: A Narrow Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest
6102.description:
The area is a dusty trail winding its way east-west between huge,
ancient trees that stand close on all sides. Not a sound is to be heard
- everything is ominously quiet. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering
the light. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.

east.description: The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.

west.description: The narrow, dusty trail leads west through the forest.

6103.name: A Narrow Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest
6103.description:
The area is where the dusty trail bends, as to avoid conflict with a
colossal trunk to the west. Not a sound is to be heard - everything is
ominously quiet. The trail leads east and south and there is a small
path leading off the trail to the north. Branches intertwine overhead,
filtering the light. Ancient trees rise on all sides.

north.description: A small path leads north off the trail.

east.description: The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.

south.description: The narrow, dusty trail leads south through the forest.

south.description: The narrow path winds its way through the trees to the south.

6130.name: A Narrow Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest
6130.description:
The area is a dusty trail winding its way westward between huge, ancient
trees that stand close on all sides. The tree trunks seem to be covered
in some sticky substance which gets much stickier towards the west!
Beware! The scent of pine and earth fills the air. Bird calls echo
through the canopy.

east.description: The narrow, dusty trail leads east through the forest.

west.description: The sticky substance is hanging like ropes between the trees just above the path.  To the west the path seems to be covered with these giant threads covered with glue.  You can sense the forces of evil coming from the west and your bones tell you it may not be such a good idea to proceed.

up.description: Above you, the trail climbs into On The spider web, where thick strands drape the branches. The air grows colder as the forest tightens.

6131.name: A Huge, Nasty Spider Web
6131.description:
A path winds along the narrow path, ducking under the sticky ropes as
you advance... > A huge, poisonous spider drops from above! A huge,
poisonous spider drops from above! A huge, poisonous spider drops from
above! > The huge, poisonous spider stings you! You resist the poison!
The huge, poisonous spider stings you! The area is poisoned! The huge,
poisonous spider stings you! The area is poisoned! The area is dead.
Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light. The scent of pine and
earth fills the air.

east.description: To the east, the shadowed path winds toward A Narrow Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest. The canopy above swallows the light and the air smells of wet earth.

6135.name: A Dusty Trail In The Deep, Dark Forest
6135.description:
The area is a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest. Ancient
grey trees loom all around. The trail continues north and east. The
scent of pine and earth fills the air. Bird calls echo through the
canopy.

north.description: The dusty trail leads north through the trees.

east.description: The dusty trail leads east through the trees.

6136.name: A Dusty Trail In The Deep, Dark Forest
6136.description:
The area is a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest.
Ancient, grey trees loom everywhere. The trail continues south and west.
A broad irregular path leads eastward away from the trail. The scent of
pine and earth fills the air. Bird calls echo through the canopy.

east.description: The trees standing on the sides of the path have scratch marks on them.

south.description: The dusty trail leads south through the trees.

west.description: The dusty trail leads west through the trees.

6137.name: At The End Of The Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest
6137.description:
The area is a dusty trail leading through the deep, dark forest. Ancient
grey trees loom all around. A small trail leads northwards and the only
other exit is east, along the main trail. Ancient trees rise on all
sides. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.

east.description: The dusty trail leads east through the trees.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Elven forest..

north.description: To the north lies In The Forest.

6142.name: Outside A Cave In The Deep, Dark Forest
6142.description:
This is the end of a broad, irregular path. To the north is a very large
ominous-looking cave opening. The trees here have many marks as if
something with huge claws has been tearing at them in rage. The scent of
pine and earth fills the air. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering
the light.

north.description: The disgusting smell of a large reptile emanates from the cave opening.

west.description: The path winds its way westward.

6143.name: The Cave Of The Green Dragon
6143.description:
This is a big natural cave. The floor is littered with bones of all
sorts and the stench is so massive that you could cut it with a knife.
The only exit is to the south. The scent of pine and earth fills the
air. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves.

south.description: The exit leads out into the forest.

6150.name: A Narrow Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest
6150.description:
This trail looks much spookier than any other that's you have seen. The
usual animal claw marks and bites on the trees are becoming few and far
between. The trail continues north. The scent of pine and earth fills
the air. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light.

north.description: The narrow trail continues north.

south.description: The trail intersects the main forest path.

6151.name: A Narrow Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest
6151.description:
This area of the trail is also very peculiar. Visible is no signs of
animal life what so ever. The structure of the surrounding trees forces
the path to make a sharp turn to the east. Ancient trees rise on all
sides. The forest floor is carpeted with fallen leaves.

east.description: The trail bends east.

south.description: The start of the trail.

west.description: To the west lies On a Sultry Trail.

6152.name: The Circle Of Trees
6152.description:
The trees here seem to form a circle around the enormous tree in the
center. You notice a wooden door carved into the huge tree to the east.
The trail that you followed to get here seems to end at the base of the
tree. Branches intertwine overhead, filtering the light. Bird calls echo
through the canopy.

east.description: The tree door is carved beautifully.

south.description: To the south lies The Edge Of The Abandoned Forest.

west.description: The bend on the trail.

6153.name: Inside The Great Tree
6153.description:
You have stepped inside of this hollowed tree. From here steps lead down
into darkness or you can exit the tree by going west. Bird calls echo
through the canopy. The scent of pine and earth fills the air.

west.description: The door is carved beautifully.

down.description: The steps look appear like they will hold your weight.

8135.name: The Plains

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies Road Through The Plains.

8135.description:
This is common grazing ground close to the city, the grass cropped short
and dotted with clumps of nettle and dock where the herds have passed. A
worn footpath slants across it toward the gatehouse road to the west.
Rooks' nests crown a distant line of elms. The common runs on east and
south.

8136.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies Road Through The Plains.

8136.description:
The grass here has been scythed in long swathes, and a stack of hay
stands under a thatched cap on a frame of poles, smelling sweet in the
sun. Stubble crunches underfoot between the cut rows. A worn path leads
from the stack toward the city gate. The road lies just west, and the
plains open out north, east and south, rolling gently under drifting
cloud.

8137.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

8137.description:
A narrow brook wanders across the plain here in a channel no wider than
a stride, crossed by a single grey plank worn smooth by many feet.
Watercress grows thick in the clear water, and forget-me-nots edge the
banks. The grass is lush and green along the stream and paler beyond.
Open land lies in every direction, north, east, south and west.

8138.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies Road Through The Plains.

8138.description:
The wreck of an old farm cart lies here in the long grass, one wheel
gone and its bed split open, with tall sorrel growing up through the
boards. The road lies only a short walk to the west. Yarrow and knapweed
cover the ground, and the air hums with the warm smell of summer grass.
The plains stretch north, east and south.

8139.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

8139.description:
A gentle rise lifts the ground a little here, enough to see far across
the swaying sea of grass. The towers of Garathorm stand to one side, and
on the other the dark line of the forest marks the edge of the plains.
Cloud shadows race across the land, chased by the wind. The grassland
leads away north, east, south and west.

8140.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

8140.description:
A tall standing stone rises from the grass here, grey and grained like
old bone, leaning a little as if listening to the wind. The turf around
its foot has never been ploughed, and harebells grow in its shelter.
From here the plains spread wide in all directions, broken only by the
shadows of passing clouds. Ways lead north, east, south and west through
the grass.

extra_descs.standing stone:
The stone stands half again the height of a man. Faint rings are cut
into its weathered face, one inside another, and the lichen grows
thickest in their grooves.

8141.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies Road Through The Plains.

8141.description:
Thistles grow tall and thick across this stretch of the plain, their
purple heads releasing drifts of silvery down whenever the wind gusts. A
sheep track winds between them, the only easy way through, and tufts of
wool cling to the spiny leaves. The road runs close by to the west. Open
grass lies north and east.

8142.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

8142.description:
The ground here rises in sandy hummocks riddled with the holes of a
large warren, the earth around each burrow kicked out in pale fans. The
grass is cropped close to the roots, and tiny paths run between the
holes. A sharp wind blows across the open ground, carrying the scent of
thyme. The warren gives way to open grass north, east and west.

8143.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

8143.description:
A broad patch of the plain here was burned not long ago, perhaps by a
lightning strike, and the ground is still black and sooty underfoot.
Bright green shoots and fireweed are already pushing up through the
ashes. The smell of charred grass lingers whenever the wind drops. The
burned ground gives way to green grass north, east and west.

8144.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

8144.description:
The plain ends abruptly here at the lip of a steep gully, its sides
overgrown with impenetrable bramble and blackthorn. Far below, a trickle
of water glints among the stones. The wind is strong at the edge,
combing the grass flat and whistling through the thorns. The only ways
on lead north and west, back across the grassland.

8145.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies Road Through The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies At The Edge Of The Plains.

8145.description:
The grass runs up to the edge of the forest here, where the first trees
of Miden'nir stand in a ragged line to the west. A thin trail of smoke
rises above the treetops beyond them, and the wind carries a whiff of
burning. Clumps of gorse grow at the forest's margin, bright with yellow
flowers. The open plains lie north, east and south.

8146.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies Road Through The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies At The Edge Of The Forest.

8146.description:
Bracken and foxgloves spread out of the woods here onto the edge of the
plain, and the grass grows rank and tussocky. A narrow track, trodden by
deer, leads west in under the dark eaves of the forest. The road lies a
short walk to the east. Northward the grassland follows the edge of the
trees.

8147.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies A Road Through The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.
