8147.description:
Young trees have crept out of the forest onto the grassland here, a
scattering of birch saplings and hazel shrubs among the long grass. The
road runs close by to the north, and southward the saplings thicken into
a light wood. Someone has woven a hunter's blind of cut branches beside
a hazel clump, now brown and sagging. Open grass leads east toward the
city and west toward the edge of the forest.

8148.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies A Road Through The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies On A Small Path.

8148.description:
The grass grows long and wild on this last stretch of the plains, where
the dusty road ends just to the north. A small path leaves the grass to
the south and plunges into the dark woods of Miden'nir, and beyond the
trees the jagged line of the mountains cuts across the sky. Gusts of
wind push the grass flat in silver waves. Open plain stretches east
toward the city.

8175.name: The Plains

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

8175.description:
The grass dips here into a shallow hollow where rainwater has gathered
in a reedy pond, its margins trampled into mud by hoofprints. Clouds
slide across its surface, mirrored in the still water. Rushes and marsh
marigolds crowd the wet ground, giving way to dry grass on the rise.
Open country leads south and west.

8176.name: The Plains

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

8176.description:
A lone hawthorn stands here on the open grass, bent almost double by
years of wind, every twisted branch streaming the same way. The turf
around it is short and springy, starred with daisies and yellow
tormentil. Far across the plain the towers of Garathorm rise grey above
the swaying grass. The plains roll on east and south under a big,
restless sky.

8177.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies A Road Through The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

8177.description:
The dusty road lies just to the south here, and a dry ditch runs
alongside it, choked with cornflowers and chicory. Fine dust from
passing carts has settled on the grass, dulling its green to grey. A
crooked old fence post stands alone in the meadow, its fence long gone.
The grassland rolls away north and west.

8178.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

8178.description:
An old cart track crosses the grass here, two deep ruts worn into the
earth and long since grown over with plantain and clover. Scarlet
poppies nod along its edges in the breeze. The track seems to lead
nowhere in particular, fading out among the tussocks. The plains stretch
north toward a reedy hollow, south toward the road, and west across
rolling grass.

8179.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies A Road Through The Plains.

8179.description:
Close to the road's end here, the plains grow rough and stony, and a
tumbled cairn of fieldstones rises waist-high from the grass, raised
long ago for some purpose no one remembers. The road runs just south,
toward the head of a forest trail. Beyond the grass the dark mass of the
forest fills the horizon. Rough grass leads north and east.

8180.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

8180.description:
A ring of grey fieldstones lies half-sunk in the turf here, the hearth
of some long-gone herders' camp, its centre still faintly darker than
the grass around it. Clover and white yarrow grow thickly over the
ground. The breeze carries the scent of hay from somewhere across the
plain. The grass rolls north toward a lone thorn tree, and on east and
south.

8190.name: The Plains

north.description: To the north lies A Road Through The Plains.

east.description: To the east lies Road Through The Plains.

south.description: To the south lies The Plains.

west.description: To the west lies The Plains.

8190.description:
The grey walls of Garathorm rise close at hand, and roads pass on two
sides of this patch of grass: one just to the north, running to the
western gate, and another to the east, leaving the city by its southern
gate. An old well with a stone curb and a rusted iron winch stands in
the trampled grass. Wheel ruts and hoofprints crisscross the ground near
the roads. The plains stretch away south and west, green and windy.

10582.name: Down the Slope to a Shore

east.description: To the east lies On a Sultry Trail.

down.description: To the down lies On the Ocean Shore.

10582.description:
The passage tilts steeply here, a slope of packed sand and loose stones
descending beneath a low, rocky overhang hung with salt-crusted roots.
The roar of the sea grows loud, and cool, briny air rushes up to meet
you, a welcome relief after the stifling heat. Footholds have been
scraped into the sand by others going before. The slope leads down
toward the ocean shore, and the trail climbs back east into the green.

10583.name: On a Sultry Trail

east.description: To the east lies On a Sultry Trail.

west.description: To the west lies Down the Slope to a Shore.

10583.description:
Here the green tunnel gives way to walls of earth and dark stone,
overhung by a matted roof of roots and creepers. The air is still warm
and damp, but the salt smell is stronger now, and the low, rhythmic boom
of surf carries from somewhere beyond the rock. Sand gritting underfoot
hints at the shore ahead. The trail continues west, and back east into
the vines.

10584.name: On a Sultry Trail

north.description: To the north lies On a Sultry Trail.

west.description: To the west lies On a Sultry Trail.

10584.description:
The walls of vines press very close here, and the trail is so narrow
that leaves brush both shoulders at once. A faint breeze stirs from the
west, bringing a breath of salt that cuts through the heavy, flower-
scented air. The ground slopes gently underfoot. The trail runs north
and west.

10585.name: On a Sultry Trail

east.description: To the east lies On a Sultry Trail.

south.description: To the south lies On a Sultry Trail.

10585.description:
The trail turns sharply here around the trunk of a vast tree whose
buttress roots stand taller than a man, forming walls of grey, ridged
wood on either side. Steam rises gently from the leaf litter in the
heavy heat. Moss hangs in dripping curtains from every surface. The way
leads east and south along the narrow green tunnel.

10586.name: On a Sultry Trail

east.description: To the east lies On a Sultry Trail.

west.description: To the west lies On a Sultry Trail.

10586.description:
Heavy blossoms of crimson and gold hang from the creepers that roof the
trail here, and their sweet, cloying scent makes the head swim. The
ground underfoot is soft with rotting leaves and pale roots. Water drips
steadily from above, warm as bathwater. The trail leads east toward the
forest and west deeper into the green.

10587.name: On a Sultry Trail

east.description: To the east lies A Narrow Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest.

west.description: To the west lies On a Sultry Trail.

10587.description:
Leaving the deep, dark forest behind to the east, the trail plunges into
a tunnel of living green, its walls woven from vines and creepers so
dense that no sky can be seen. The air is hot and thick, heavy with the
smell of damp leaves and blossom. Sweat beads on your skin within a few
steps. The trail continues west through the green gloom.

3500.name: wyvern
3500.long_desc: A monstrous wyvern slowly circles just above your head.
3500.description:
This huge winged creature looks really menacing as it circles only inches
above your head, flapping its wings and squawking very loudly.

3501.name: goblin
3501.long_desc: A mountain goblin is wandering around mumbling to himself...
3501.description:
You see before you a small and twisted creature with knotted muscles and
disgustingly green skin.  Doesn't look like the type you'd invite to dinner.

3502.name: goblin
3502.long_desc: A goblin lieutenant stands here, attempting to get his men in order.
3502.description:
The goblin lieutenant is rather angry, and looking for one of his men to
beat up upon, but maybe you will do just fine...

3503.name: the Goblin King
3503.long_desc: Grukthar the Goblin King towers over his throne, snarling.
3503.description:
The leader doesn't look too happy that you have found him here.  He grabs
for his shortsword and lunges for your neck.

phases.message: The Goblin King beats his chest and calls for reinforcements!
The Goblin King flies into a berserk rage!

abilities.name: Bomb Toss
abilities.telegraph: The Goblin King lights a crude bomb and hurls it high!

3504.name: boy
3504.long_desc: A small boy sits here, licking his wounds.
3504.description:
The poor boy has numerous cuts and scratches, but appears to be all right.
He is apparently the only survivor of the ambush.

3505.name: innkeeper
3505.long_desc: The Innkeeper stands here, cleaning glasses.
3505.description:
The Innkeeper now spends most of his days waiting for customers, while the
nights are spent watching out for goblins.  His inn is no longer the happy
place that is used to be in days past.

3506.name: bard
3506.long_desc: A sullen bard is here, drinking away his problems.
3506.description:
You can smell the alcohol on his breath from across the room.  This poor
bard has been sitting here quite a while, drinking himself into oblivion.

3507.name: horseman
3507.long_desc: A dark horseman is here, mounted on his black steed.
3507.description:
The man is obviously an outlaw, and has no qualms about slashing you into
little bits.

6000.description:
He is six feet tall and looks quite strong, muscles bulging under his heavy,
chequered shirt.  His features are worn with hard work and his expression is
one of a peaceful man leading a simple life.
6000.long_desc: John the Lumberjack is here, looking for some trees to chop down.
6000.name: john

6001.description: It is a small, furry creature with long ears and big feet.
6001.long_desc: A small rabbit is foraging in the bushes here.
6001.name: rabbit

6002.description:
The bear is a big, brown, furry animal with very large claws and very sharp
teeth.  It doesn't resemble those cute little dolls from toy shops at all.
6002.long_desc: A big, brown, angry-looking bear is here.
6002.name: bear

6003.description:
This small, furry creature with long ears and big feet has been attacked
by the dreaded rabbit rabies, a horrible disease that turns helpless and
innocent rabbits into ferocious and bloodthirsty monsters.
6003.long_desc: A ferocious rabbit is here, glaring hungrily at you.
6003.name: rabbit

6004.description:
She is a graceful creature on long, slender legs, and with large, brown eyes
looking back at you with an air of watchful interest.
6004.long_desc: A fallow deer is grazing peacefully here.
6004.name: deer

6005.description: It is a large fox with beautiful, red-brown fur and a long, thick bushy tail.
6005.long_desc: A brown fox is stalking rabbits through the underbrush here.
6005.name: fox

6006.description: The bird isn't going to live much longer, by the looks of it.
6006.long_desc: A large bird with a broken wing has been cornered here.
6006.name: bird

6007.description:
The bobcat has sharp claws and teeth, and will probably eat you instead of
the bird if you give it the chance.
6007.long_desc: A medium sized bobcat is stalking a bird here.
6007.name: bobcat

6008.description: The sparrow looks like it is enjoying life.
6008.long_desc: A sparrow is flapping around by the ground.
6008.name: sparrow

6009.description: The robin looks quite intent on finding a bug or worm to eat.
6009.long_desc: A robin is hopping around looking for bugs to eat.
6009.name: robin

6010.description:
It peers out of its nest at you anxiously, seeming to plead silently with
you to leave it alone.
6010.long_desc: A squirrel is here seeking refuge in its nest.
6010.name: squirrel

6011.description:
The badger is slowly awakening and peering up at you from its burrow. You
know that it won't be moving this slow for long.  Its sharp claws and teeth
catch your attention when you consider killing it.
6011.long_desc: A furry brown badger is curled up under a log here.
6011.name: badger

6012.description:
This happy creature seems to pay you no heed as it goes about its search for
nuts among the leaves and twigs on the ground here.
6012.long_desc: A grey squirrel with a bushy tail is foraging for nuts here.
6012.name: grey

6013.description:
The absolute zenith of hyperactivity, this small rodent seems to never tire
of running up, down, and around the trees in this area.  If you could ever
catch it, you imagine it would make an easy meal.
6013.long_desc: A small brown-red chipmunk dashes from tree to tree here.
6013.name: chipmunk

6014.description: The bird eyes you warily, but continues with its meal.
6014.long_desc: A large black bird flits about here, picking at bits of carrion.
6014.name: crow

6015.description:
It sickens you to even look at this foul bird.  Bits of dried gore stick to
its beak, and unidentifiable organs hang from its talons and feathers.  
It sees you and attacks, protecting its horrible feast!
6015.long_desc: A grotesque vulture covered in blood and gore is here feeding madly.
6015.name: grotesque

6016.description:
This young male deer is drinking from the edge of the lake and watching you
warily.  His antlers are not full size yet, and will no doubt be quite 
impressive in a few years.
6016.long_desc: A young 5-point buck is drinking from the lake here.
6016.name: buck

6017.description: The fish looks about the right size for a meal.
6017.long_desc: A fish is swimming about here.
6017.name: fish

6018.description: The duckling is adorable, it looks most of all like a tiny furball.
6018.long_desc: A duckling is swimming around in the pond.
6018.name: duckling

6098.name: forest hermit
6098.long_desc: An old hermit sits here in the hollow of a massive oak, whittling a small figurine.
6098.description: His hair is tangled with leaves and small twigs, and his clothes are patched together from animal hides and bark. Despite his wild appearance, his eyes are sharp and knowing.

talk_responses.hello: The hermit looks up from his whittling. 'The light forest is kind enough, if you respect it. But never go east after dark — the dark forest has teeth, friend. Literal teeth. The trees themselves hunger for flesh there.'
talk_responses.dark forest: He shakes his head slowly. 'Something corrupted it long ago. The creatures there were once gentle. Now even the deer have gone mad. There's a hidden glade deep within though, still pure. Follow the silver mushrooms if you can find them.'
talk_responses.default: The hermit returns to his whittling. 'The forest provides for those who listen.'
talk_responses.next: The hermit strokes his beard thoughtfully. 'If you've proven yourself against the wolves and bandits here, the Great Northern Forest to the north holds far greater dangers. Levels 8 and above, I'd wager. Or seek the mines of Moria — dwarves speak of trouble in the deep.'

606000.name: goblin scout
606000.long_desc: A goblin scout from a roving band crouches low, watching the path with narrowed eyes.
606000.description:
This lean goblin is smaller and quicker than the brutes of the war-
camps, its green skin smeared with soot and mud to hide it in the gloom.
It wears a jerkin of patched leather hung with snares, and a notched
dagger is thrust through its belt. Its long ears twitch at every sound.

606001.name: hare brown
606001.long_desc: A brown hare sits up in the grass, its long ears turning to catch the wind.
606001.description:
The hare is lean and long-legged, its tawny coat flecked with black and
its ears tipped with dark fur. Its large amber eyes are set far to the
sides of its head, so that it seems to watch everything at once. At the
first sign of danger it will be away across the plain in great zigzag
bounds.

3501.name: sword
3501.room_desc: A long sword has been left here.

3502.name: club
3502.room_desc: A simple looking wooden club is here.

3503.name: jacket
3503.room_desc: A studded leather jacket is lying on the ground.

3505.name: corpse
3505.room_desc: A mutilated corpse has been left on the ground here.

3506.name: corpse
3506.room_desc: A mutilated corpse has been left on the ground here.

3507.name: dagger
3507.room_desc: A beautiful looking dagger is stuck in the ground.

3508.name: gyroscope
3508.room_desc: A small toy is spinning about on the ground here.

3509.name: a jagged goblin crown
3509.room_desc: A jagged crown fashioned from scrap metal lies here.

3510.name: a bomb satchel
3510.room_desc: A soot-stained satchel of goblin bombs sits here.

3511.name: a kingly cleaver
3511.room_desc: A brutal cleaver etched with goblin runes lies here.

6000.name: axe
6000.room_desc: A heavy lumber axe lies here.

6001.name: forest stalker's leather armor
6001.room_desc: A set of forest stalker's leather armor lies here.

6003.name: forest stalker's boots
6003.short_desc: a pair of forest stalker's boots

6004.name: forest stalker's longbow
6004.room_desc: A finely crafted longbow lies here.

6005.name: chest
6005.room_desc: A wooden chest stands in the corner.

6006.name: key
6006.room_desc: A small brass key lies here.

6007.name: coins
6007.room_desc: Some gold coins lie piled up in a heap on the floor.

6010.name: blackberries
6010.room_desc: Some blackberries grow on a bush nearby.

6012.name: sign
6012.room_desc: A large sign mounted on a pole is standing by the roadside.

6013.name: barrel
6013.room_desc: A water barrel has been left here.

6014.name: water
6014.room_desc: A small brook trickles through the forest beside the path.

6018.name: slab
6018.room_desc: A large piece of freshly cut boar meat is on the ground here.

6019.name: tusks
6019.room_desc: A pair of large boar tusks have been dropped here.

6022.name: egg
6022.room_desc: A small bluish egg has been left here.

6023.name: meat
6023.room_desc: A large piece of rabbit meat.

6050.name: a barkbound journal
6050.room_desc: A barkbound journal rests on the platform.
6050.description: The pages are stitched with reed fibers and smell of pine.
6050.lore_text: "We ward the forest paths, guiding the lost and turning back those who would burn the groves."

6051.name: an oath of Haon-Dor
6051.room_desc: A scroll of green vellum lies atop the altar.
6051.description: Leaf-inked vows spiral down the page.
6051.lore_text: "To the roots we pledge, to the canopy we answer, and to the wild we belong."

6052.name: a fae-etched casket
6052.room_desc: A fae-etched casket is tucked beneath the bench.
6052.description: Delicate etchings shimmer when you look away.

6053.name: a moonlit antler charm
6053.room_desc: A pale antler charm glows softly here.
6053.description: Carved from shed antler and bound with silver thread.

6054.name: a carved oak key
6054.room_desc: A carved oak key has been wedged into a stump.
6054.description: The key is inlaid with small leaf motifs.

6058.name: sprig of life
6058.room_desc: A sprig of life lies here.

6095.name: wooden signpost
6095.room_desc: A carved wooden signpost stands at the forest entrance.
6095.readable_text:
=== LIGHT FOREST ===
Recommended Level: 3-10
East: Return to Garathorm
Deeper into forest: Increasing danger
Seek Ranger Thornwood for guidance and quests

706000.name: dagger notched goblin blade
706000.room_desc: A crude dagger with a notched, blackened blade lies here.
706000.description: A crude dagger of black iron, hammered out on some goblin forge. Its edge is notched like a saw from hard use, and the grip is wrapped in strips of greasy hide. It is ugly, but it is sharp.
